prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1491; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just say I'm the driver of the blue sedan, if that's all right.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was heading through the intersection on a green light, going straight through. The other car came from my right side, from the cross street.
Q: How fast were you traveling?
A: Not fast. Maybe the posted speed, somewhere around there. I'd just cleared the crosswalk.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Only a second before. I hit the brakes but there wasn't time. It hit my passenger side, the front door area.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, and the airbag on my side deployed.
Q: Did you receive medical attention after the collision?
A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They checked my neck and back and said I had strains in both areas.
Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?
A: Yes. My neck is stiff, especially when I turn to check mirrors, and my lower back aches after sitting more than twenty minutes. I've been going to physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the injuries?
A: A few days so far. My doctor has me on light duty for now.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I didn't run the light. I was doing what I was supposed to do.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Okay, thank you.
